competitors_mentioned: Udemy – Shadow Work Course and Workbook

answer_verbatim:
If you want **online courses that are specifically about shadow work and include a spiritual-development angle**, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s shadow courses**, **Udemy’s Shadow Work courses**, and **Insight Timer’s guided shadow-work course**.[9][10][13][5]

Here’s a practical shortlist:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Jung Platform – Shadow courses / Encounters with the Shadow** | Deeper Jungian study | Focuses on Jungian shadow work, including the difference between **personal and collective shadow**, with in-depth lectures and lifetime access.[9][13] |
| **Jung Platform – Engage the Shadow** | Applied practice | Includes **10 video and 10 audio recordings** and emphasizes practical shadow-work techniques you can use in daily life.[10] |
| **Insight Timer – Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing and Growth** | Guided self-reflection | A meditation-style course centered on uncovering and healing hidden parts of yourself.[5] |
| **Udemy – Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self Certification** | Beginner-friendly overview | Explicitly frames shadow work as a path to **self-mastery** and **spiritual awakening**.[3] |
| **Udemy – Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Structured self-study | Includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices aimed at **spiritual transformation**.[14] |
| **Udemy – Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices** | Broader practice range | Covers shadow parts, reactivity, and links shadow work to **personal and spiritual development**.[15] |

A few selection tips:
- Choose **Jung Platform** if you want the most clearly **Jungian** and psychologically grounded material.[9][13]
- Choose **Udemy** if you want a wide range of affordable, self-paced options with workbooks and guided exercises.[3][14][15]
- Choose **Insight Timer** if you prefer a more **meditative, reflective** learning style.[5]

If your goal is *spiritual practice* rather than just shadow work, the best fit among the results is probably **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** on Udemy because it explicitly includes **meditations, prayers, and practices** alongside shadow-work lessons.[14]
